question: On 8 February 2009, for the 51st Grammy Awards, ___________ won in the category Contemporary World Music Album for his collaborative album Global Drum Project along with Mickey Hart, Sikiru Adepoju and Giovanni Hidalgo.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Zakir Hussain**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **On 8 February 2009 **for 51st Grammy Awards, Zakir Hussain won the Grammy in the Contemporary.
 
• He is the most established offspring of **tabla player Ustad Alla Rakha**.
